Something else I think we need to include is authorship on intent and on sessions, and maybe other things, so that if multiple people are recording intent, it is possible to detangle contradictions or know who to talk to about inconsistencies, to help the humans reach agreement.  The intent will usually be affirming or orthogonal and consistent but even in that case the "according to whom" needs to be recorded.  We don't need bulletproof provenance or signatures or anything, just some mechanism to trace intent back to people so that humans can open conversations with each other when appropriate.  Does it make sense what I'm looking for?  Restate what you think I'm wanting.
